title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
Every position in this record is paper: paper signals only, and no real orders are placed anywhere in the record. 1 trade says nothing about a strategy. The live record for trend-daily-v005 counts from 1 October 2026, and trend-daily-v006 counts from 9 October 2026. The initial live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM later exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close at 1.703, which is -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. The exit rule was a close below the 10-day low; the measured close was 1.703; the resulting net figure is -17.9% after 30 bps. A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since, with no recorded exit and therefore no measured result. In testing, losses were common and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel.

## Open positions and the paper frame

The record lists 1 entry still open: NEAR at 5.896 on 12 October 2026. That entry has been open since 12 October 2026, and no exit has been recorded for it. Because no exit has been recorded, there is no closed-trade result for NEAR; its outcome remains unproven. The 19 November 2026 snapshot shows 0 positions open on paper for htf-rsi-v007, trend-daily-v005, and trend-daily-v006. These engine states and the NEAR entry are reported as separate lines in the record. All positions described here are paper positions, and no real orders are placed anywhere in the record. 1 trade says nothing about a strategy, so a single open entry or a single closed trade should not be read as a verdict on an engine.

## Closed trades so far

ATOM provides the clearest closed-trade example in the record. The entry was at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. The exit occurred below the 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703. The measured result is -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. The rule was an exit below the 10-day low; the measurement was the close at 1.703; the outcome is -17.9% after 30 bps. htf-rsi-v007 has 5 closed trades so far, and its average net per trade is reported as null. trend-daily-v005 has 6 closed trades so far, with an average of -13.22% net per trade. trend-daily-v006 has 7 closed trades so far, with an average of -13.34% net per trade. The closed-trade counts are 5, 6, and 7. The averages are reported engine by engine; no further performance claim is made from them. A losing start is consistent with the testing expectation that losses were common, even though the average winner was roughly +19%.

## Market filter status

trend-daily-v005 has the Bitcoin market filter off. trend-daily-v006 also has the Bitcoin market filter off. The snapshot shows 0 positions open on paper for both engines. The filter status is part of the engine state. The measurement is that it is off for both trend engines. The observed companion measurement is 0 open positions for both. The record does not forecast a change. The same status is posted to the channel.

## Nearest breakout distances

trend-daily-v005 is closest to its 20-day breakout for TRXUSDT, ATOMUSDT, and THETAUSDT. TRXUSDT is 12.12% below its high. ATOMUSDT is 16.17% below its high. THETAUSDT is 18.02% below its high. trend-daily-v006 is closest to its 20-day breakout for JUPUSDT, TRXUSDT, and ATOMUSDT. JUPUSDT is 1.57% below its high. TRXUSDT is 12.12% below its high. ATOMUSDT is 16.17% below its high. These figures describe distance to a breakout level in the record. They are not entries, and no position is opened by being close to a breakout. The list is read from the same snapshot as the engine states.

## Where the record is published

The live snapshot was read at 2026-11-19T03:23:01.291Z. The record updates continuously, so a later read can show different positions, closed trades, or filter states. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. Checking those places is how to confirm the figures quoted here. No real orders are placed anywhere in the record, and every figure above remains paper data.
